test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 2).
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

ARCS : ENHN :: GHAT : KDFO :: MUSK : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter ⇒ (4) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (4) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter ⇒ (5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter ⇒ (5) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• ARCS : ENHN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e2c2da925b1ca9292af405541b3d9cadc01467da496771fe63a4269c57f28e3.png] 

And,

 
• GHAT : KDFO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e971e169c25fa969842ad2ad0ea03a423fdfdbd1290b553727930463a538cc6.png] 

Similarly,

 
• MUSK : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd07b17fbf3eb7d19bee834b16f8ffb0759ec75435db4808577b35e1c0d6b3f9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**QQXF**".

74:T
